monsters.name: Monsters
monsters.description: Faction ability: keeps a random unit card on the battlefield after each round.

skellige.name: Skellige
skellige.description: Faction ability: at the start of round 3, play 2 random cards from the graveyard.

leader.name: Leader
leader.description: Faction leader card with a unique once-per-match ability.

hero.name: Hero
hero.description: Hero unit: immune to special cards and most abilities.

unit.name: Unit
unit.description: Regular unit card placed on a combat row.

special.name: Special
special.description: Non-unit special card (e.g. Decoy, Commander's Horn, Scorch, Mardroeme).

weather.name: Weather
weather.description: Weather effect card that weakens a combat row (or clears weather).

base.name: Base game
base.description: Available in The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt base game.

hearts-of-stone.name: Hearts of Stone
hearts-of-stone.description: Added in the Hearts of Stone expansion.

blood-and-wine.name: Blood and Wine
blood-and-wine.description: Added in the Blood and Wine expansion.

close.name: Close Combat
close.description: Placed on the Close Combat (melee) row.

ranged.name: Ranged Combat
ranged.description: Placed on the Ranged Combat row.

agile.name: Agile
agile.description: May be placed on either Close Combat or Ranged Combat.

hero.name: Hero
hero.description: Not affected by any Special Cards or abilities.

spy.name: Spy
spy.description: Place on your opponent's battlefield (counts toward their total) and draw 2 cards from your deck.

medic.name: Medic
medic.description: Choose one non-Hero, non-Special card from your discard pile and play it instantly.

muster.name: Muster
muster.description: Find any cards with the same name in your deck and play them instantly.

tight_bond.name: Tight Bond
tight_bond.description: Place next to a card with the same name to double the strength of both cards.

morale_boost.name: Morale Boost
morale_boost.description: Adds +1 strength to all other units in the same row.

agile.name: Agile
agile.description: Can be placed in either the Close Combat or the Ranged Combat row. Cannot be moved once placed.

scorch.name: Scorch
scorch.description: Destroys the strongest unit(s) on the battlefield (or a specific row, depending on the card).

berserker.name: Berserker
berserker.description: Transforms into a stronger form when a Mardroeme card is on its row.

mardroeme.name: Mardroeme
mardroeme.description: Triggers transformation of all Berserker cards on the same row.

commanders_horn.name: Commander's Horn
commanders_horn.description: Doubles the strength of all unit cards in the selected row. Limit one per row.

decoy.name: Decoy
decoy.description: Swap with a non-Hero unit on your side of the battlefield to return that unit to your hand.

summon_avenger.name: Summon Avenger
summon_avenger.description: When this card is removed from the battlefield, it is replaced by a stronger unit from your deck.

weather_frost.name: Biting Frost
weather_frost.description: Sets the strength of all Close Combat units to 1 for both players.

weather_fog.name: Impenetrable Fog
weather_fog.description: Sets the strength of all Ranged Combat units to 1 for both players.

weather_rain.name: Torrential Rain
weather_rain.description: Sets the strength of all Siege units to 1 for both players.

weather_storm.name: Skellige Storm
weather_storm.description: Sets the strength of all Ranged and Siege units to 1 for both players.

clear_weather.name: Clear Weather
clear_weather.description: Removes all Weather effects from the battlefield.
